publication_status: Published profile — taxonomy qualifications in notes

distribution.summary: Taiwan; Jiangxi; Fujian; Guangdong; Hainan; Yunnan

taxonomy_summary: Dinoplatypus flectus (Niijima & Murayama, 1931). Source-specific taxonomic history and uncertainties follow.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus triplurus
taxonomic_history.note: Beaver (2013:23) synonymized this name under D. flectus.

taxonomic_history.name: Dinoplatypus flectus
taxonomic_history.note: New combination made by Beaver & Shih (2003:79–80).

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus lepidus flectus
taxonomic_history.note: Murayama (1931:197) replaced a preoccupied formosanus name.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus lepidus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Original Murayama (1925:214–215) describes the two homonymous species-group names in the same genus.

nomenclature_note: Replacement flectus Murayama 1931:197 verified; 1925 formosanus homonymy, unnecessary Schedl 1941 murayamaensis, Beaver & Shih 2003 combination and Beaver 2013 triplurus synonymy verified; uncertain Psidium guaiacum excluded.
